name: Lagon Bistro
tagline: Beach kitchen & bar · Flic en Flac
description: Grilled catch of the day, Creole curries and rum cocktails with your feet in the sand on Flic en Flac beach, Mauritius. Open daily for lunch, sunset and dinner.

facts.label: Our fish comes in with the Flic en Flac fishermen every morning.
Everything from the grill is cooked over casuarina wood and charcoal.
Sixty seats under the filaos, a few steps from the water.

day.title: Lunch in the shade
day.text: Grilled catch of the day, octopus salad and a cold coconut, under the filao trees.

day.title: Sunset happy hour
day.text: Two rum punches for the price of one while the sun drops behind the horizon.

day.title: Dinner by lantern light
day.text: Creole curries, lobster from the grill and lanterns on the sand.

day.title: Late under the stars
day.text: Dessert, a last cocktail, and live séga music every Friday.

events.title: Séga Fridays
events.text: Live ravanne and séga music on the sand, with a set menu from the grill.

events.title: Sunday family barbecue
events.text: A long, slow lunch: whole fish, grilled chicken, salads and a kids' corner.

events.title: Private events
events.text: Birthdays, weddings and team dinners on the beach for up to 80 guests.
